Detailed Scope of procurement: The contractor/bidder shall design, manufacture, supply, deliver, install, and commission of footstep and B edside Movable screen specified in the bid document. (i) Design & Material Requirements · The bidder should have a competent design team capable of creating footstep and Bedside Movable scre en designs that are visually appealing, functional, and aligned with the institution's requirements. · The manufacturing process should involve skilled craftsmen and modern techniques to ensure high-qualit y furniture items. · The bidder should provide details about their design and manufacturing capabilities, including samples fo r the present work and/or relevant details of previous work. · The design should be aesthetically pleasing, ergonomic, and suitable for the intended use as per the user department.

· All exposed surfaces shall be smooth, non-porous, easy to clean, and resistant to corrosion and disinfecta nts. · The successful bidder is required to promptly submit the following documents within 3 days after issuanc e of PO and shall obtain the approval of the EIC. a. Comprehensive, Detailed design, including shop drawings and 3D visual representations. b. Detailed specifications outlining the materials, make, model, and shade intended for use in the said item . EIC reserves the right to suggest modifications in the design and drawings submitted and all such modifica tions are to be carried out by the bidder, until the approval is obtained, without any extra cost and resubmi t & get the same approved from the EIC, within the next day, before proceeding with the sample submissio n and manufacturing. Nothing extra is payable on account of changes in design and subsequent manufact uring. (ii) Site Measurement & Coordination The bidder shall visit the site before fabrication to verify dimensions, site conditions, utility requirements, a nd access constraints. Coordination with the ICTREC centre authorities shall be maintained throughout the execution period. (iii) Quality and Materials: · The bidder should emphasize the use of premium quality materials that meet standards and ensure dura bility. · The materials should be sourced responsibly, with consideration for sustainability and environmental imp act. · The bidder should provide information about the specific materials they intend to use for different furnitu re items and highlight their quality standards and certifications. · The proposed building is a prestigious project and quality of work is of paramount importance. Bidder sha ll have to engage well-experienced skilled labour and deploy modern T&P and other equipment to execute the work. · Protection of flooring, protection of scratch on footstep and Bedside Movable screen items shall be done by providing suitable covering etc. to achieve an installation of international standards and up keeping of q uality assurance shall be of paramount importance, as such. · All materials and workmanship shall be subject to inspection and approval by the client/consultant. · Defective or non-conforming materials shall be replaced immediately at no additional cost. · The contractor shall ensure proper finishing, alignment, levelling, and functionality of footsteps and Bedsi de Movable screen. (iv) Installation & Safety Responsibility During installation, if any damage occurs to: ICTREC property Building finishes Existing utilities Equipment or infrastructure the same shall be repaired/replaced by the contractor at their own cost to the satisfaction of the client. (v) Cleaning & Waste Disposal After completion of work, the contractor shall: · Clean the entire work area thoroughly · Remove debris, packing materials, and waste from site · Dispose of waste as per hospital guidelines The site shall be handed over in neat, hygienic, and operational condition. (vi) Supply and Installation:

· The bidder shall ensure a smooth supply chain process, including proper packaging and safe transportati on of furniture items to the specified location. · They should have experience in handling furniture installation and assembly, ensuring that the items are correctly set up and ready for use. · The bidder should strictly follow the delivery timeline. · The bidder should handle packaging, transportation, and any necessary assembly or installation of the fu rniture items. · The supply of materials connected to this work is to be managed completely by the bidder at their own ar rangement including necessary loading, unloading, transportation, safety, storage arrangements except fo r storage space on “as is where is” basis shall be made available to the bidder at site. The space manage ment as well as material management shall be responsibility of the bidder. Bidder shall however be respon sible not to create any hindrance to other agencies who are executing work in the same premises. · Proper care should be taken during transportation and installation to ensure the footsteps and Bedside M ovable screen are delivered without any damage. (vii) Compliance and Safety: · The bidder should adhere to relevant safety standards and regulations governing furniture manufacturing and use. · They should provide documentation or certifications demonstrating compliance with safety requirements. · The bidder should ensure that the furniture items are free from hazardous substances, such as toxic che micals or allergens, to promote a safe and healthy environment. · The furniture items should comply with all relevant safety standards, regulations, and codes. · The bidder should provide necessary certifications or documentation to demonstrate compliance with saf ety requirements. · It is essential to ensure that the furniture items are free from any hazardous substances or materials. (viii) Completion Timeline The entire work shall be completed within the stipulated time schedule provided by the client. Any delay without valid approval may attract penalties as per contract conditions. (ix) Final Handover Final handover shall be considered complete only after: · Successful installation · Cleaning of site · Rectification of defects (if any) · Approval by the client/authorized representative (x) Warranty and After-Sales Service: · The bidder should provide Two year warranty period for the said items, covering any defects in materials or workmanship. · In case of any manufacturing defects (including damaged caused by termite) found in the product within 2 years from the date of installation, the same should be repaired/replaced and made good, on the cost of the supplier. · The replacement shall have to be carried out within 10 days of the intimation being received from the Ins titute. .
